description: rail data (railway lines, stations) is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Robert Jeansoulin (CNRS). Initially built upon SNCF geo-coded stations (source circa 2016), then augmented by many older stations, from secondary lines, rural tramways, industrial lines. The GeoJson structure has been slightly modified, in order to allow easier constraint checking and quality assurance. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. Formats: JSON. Size stated: 639573. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Custom terms specific to this dataset. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
